profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer, UMass Boston & GA graduate, drone and photography nerd

positions.title: Immersive Web Development Program
positions.description:
Graduate of General Assembly’s Web Development Immersive (WDI) program.  WDI is a 12-week, 600+ hours training program designed to cover the gamut of skills necessary to develop full stack web applications.  This is accomplished by focusing on the tools and best practices used by professional developers and covers all facets of the role.  This includes (but is not limited to) extensive use of Git/Github, HTML5/CSS3, jQuery, Sass, Bootstrap JavaScript, Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MVC development using Ruby on Rails, and leveraging APIs using AJAX.

Among my achievements during this course was the completion of four projects:  

KaizenRMS – My capstone project is an online menu system for small and midsized restaurants. I wanted it to represent the culmination of everything I learned during my time at GA and happily it does. It is a responsive HTML5/CSS3 app using Bootstrap, JavaScript, and jQuery with a Ruby on Rails back-end API.   

Clique – A geolocation-based picture-sharing app created as part of a group project with an amazing team. The front-end is built using HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript, as well as the HTML5 geolocation and Google’s reverse geocoding APIs using an Express/MongoDB back-end. 

Robcoin – A banking app for a pseudo-cryptocurrency. The front-end was built with HTML5/CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and jQuery with a Ruby on Rails back-end API. As my first full stack app it was particularly challenging but extremely rewarding to have successfully completed it.  

T3 – A tic-tac-toe game built using HTML5/CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript and jQuery.  My first foray into the development world. I’ll never forget the exhilaration of typing those first lines of code.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Lead project manager for an infrastructure project tasked with deploying multicast network capabilities for a Cisco VBRICK video conferencing platform.  The project scope included 51 sites in the Americas, APAC, and EMEA regions.  

Significant accomplishments included:
* Coordination of the development of a new network standard and rollout methodology.
* Planning and management of the pilot deployment and site rollouts.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
Worked as part of the Global Information Systems Special Projects team.  Primary responsibilities included project management of IT integration resulting from corporate mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures using the PMBOK as well as internally development standards and procedures.

Significant accomplishments included:
  * The successful coordination of the network infrastructure integration of sites across Central & South America into Sanofi's global standard systems and platforms.
  * The successful roll-out of Sanofi's global ERP system to our Mexico locations.
  * Assist with the creation and continuous improvement of internal team documents and procedures.  This included a lead role in developing draft processes for our divestiture methodology.

positions.title: Service Analyst
positions.description: Lead resource responsible for the implementation planning and process development of BMC’s Service Level Management platform. The project’s primary objective is to enhance our existing ITIL practices by enabling us to monitor and report on Sanofi’s service level agreements.  Currently working with our BMC account team to plan an on-site workshop that will bring together representatives of the various Sanofi business and technical services with BMC subject matter experts.  Primary tasks include leading the development of the workshop.  Specifically, this includes creating the agenda, working with service level owners and managers to define company specific use cases, and workshop logistical planning.

positions.title: IT Technologist - Principal
positions.description:
Design, deployment, documentation, and support of infrastructure components across a global organization.  This included our Nortel and Juniper remote access platforms, SecurID authentication technologies, and Checkpoint-based firewall and business-to-business VPN infrastructure, and Cisco-based local and wide area networks. 

Responsibilities included serving as the temporary manager of the Network Service Delivery Team (NSDT) when the full-time manager was on vacation or required to travel.  I functioned as a full member of the NSDT management organization with all associated responsibilities.  This included serving as the primary escalation point for peer team members and project managers regarding network resource assignments, project portfolio management, incident and change issues, as well as weekly status reports to senior management.  

Lead resource for the development of internal support and team processes, network performance monitoring, cost analysis and metrics reporting.  I also served as the escalation point for peers, management, project managers, and other IT departments on Network Service Delivery Team (NSDT) processes related questions.  These covered a wide range of areas including Genzyme’s ITIL-based incident and change management procedures as well as project management methodology processes.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description: Responsible for the administration, management, and support the network and servers.
